title: Lab Notes
titleTooltip: View and manage all lab notes. Search by title or tags, and filter by status.
subtitle: Experiment record management and search
filterTooltip: Status filter: Draft (writing), In Progress (conducting), Signed (verified), Locked (immutable). Admins can unlock locked notes.
templateFilterBanner: Showing notes created from a specific protocol
empty: No notes yet. Create a new note to get started.
unlockDesc: Unlock note "{{title}}". The status will change to "Draft" and this action will be recorded in the audit log.
unlockWarning: This action cannot be undone and will be recorded in the audit trail with admin information.
unlockSuccessDesc: Unlocked by admin — recorded in audit log.
deleteDesc: Delete note "{{title}}". Deleted notes cannot be recovered.

editor.tooltip: Lab note editor. Write in Markdown format. You can add attachments, link reagents/equipment, and view version history. Notes are locked after signing.
editor.signTooltip: Signing will hash the note content for timestamped certification. Content cannot be modified after signing.
editor.signWarning: After signing, the note will be locked and cannot be modified. Do you want to proceed?
editor.signSuccessDesc: The note has been signed and locked.

attachment.saveFirst: Save the note first to attach files.
attachment.dropOrClick: Drag files or click to upload
attachment.hint: Multiple files supported: PDF, images, data files (max 50MB)
attachment.lockedNote: Cannot add files to signed/locked notes.
attachment.lockedMsg: Cannot add files to signed/locked notes.

link.title: Linked Items
link.tooltip: Link reagents, samples, and equipment used in this note for traceability. Links are bidirectional with inventory items.
link.saveFirst: Save the note first to link items.

revision.title: Version History
revision.tooltip: Shows all revision history in chronological order.
